title: Cozy Cryptids
subtitle: A Cute Spooky Coloring Book of Mothman, Bigfoot and Lake Monsters at Home
back_blurb:
Bigfoot knits scarves by the fire. Mothman hangs fairy lights on the porch. Nessie sips tea in the middle of the lake.

Welcome to the secret, snug and surprisingly sweet home life of the world's most famous cryptids! Cozy Cryptids invites you into 30 charming scenes where legendary creatures bake cinnamon rolls, tend their gardens, read by candlelight and throw the coziest tea parties in the forest.

- 30 original full-page illustrations
- Bold, clean outlines for relaxing coloring
- Single theme, endless cozy vibes
- Perfect gift for folklore fans and cute-creepy lovers

Grab your pencils and get cozy!
description_html:
Ever wondered what Bigfoot does on a rainy Sunday?


He knits a scarf by the fire, of course. Cozy Cryptids takes the most famous creatures of folklore and invites them home: Mothman hangs fairy lights on the porch, Nessie sips tea in the middle of her lake, the Chupacabra naps in a quilted basket and the Jersey Devil runs a tiny forest coffee cart.


Inside you will find:
  • 30 original full-page coloring illustrations
  • Bold, clean outlines with large open areas, relaxing for adults and teens
  • Bigfoot, Mothman, Nessie, Yeti, Chupacabra, Jersey Devil, Thunderbird, Frogman and more
  • Hygge scenes: baking, gardening, reading, crafting, stargazing and tea parties
  • 6 x 9 inch size, easy to carry and perfect for gifting

A cute-creepy gift for fans of cryptozoology, cottagecore, cozy Halloween and anyone who believes the woods are friendlier than they look.


Grab your colored pencils and spend a cozy night in with the cryptids.
